payload.text: New leak to file and fix at the resume (cc's, found 19 Oct closing out, on hv's "Nix TMPDIR's detritus"): 54 prez-<pid>-<stamp>.html files in TMPDIR from prez's own deck.rs scratch() (deck.rs:384), not its tests, dated 18:47Z during the gate and AT runs, so a path of prez's (pdf or present, under the ATs or bats) leaves its scratch html behind. Removed with the 740 old test dirs. Design first, through vc.
